payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how reordering is performed to match words between languages with different word orders, specifically through pre-ordering techniques.

claims.text: Reordering is achieved by applying pre-ordering rules to English sentences to match the word order of the source language, such as swapping noun phrases and verbs.
The CFILT-preorder system uses generic and Hindi-tuned rules to improve reordering for English to Indian language translations.
Pre-ordering significantly improves translation quality by addressing word-order divergence between source and assisting languages.
